items.evidence: Log lines 2-193 show 96 aspirates of 18 uL from reservoir A1, each dispensed into a distinct pcr_plate well, all with one tip.
Log shows 1 uL from each colony_plate well to the matching pcr_plate well (lines 196-1153), then 1 uL from each primer_plate well to the matching pcr_plate well (1156-1537), all with the P20.
Each colony and each primer transfer is preceded by its own pick up tip and followed by drop tip; only the master mix reuses a single tip, which is allowed.
protocol.comment records sealing and 98C 30 s; 30x[98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s]; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.
Steps and volumes match the task, including a 3x mix after the template; the comments are accurate and no steps are invented.

judge.summary: The protocol dispenses 18 uL master mix to all 96 wells, then adds 1 uL colony template with a 3x mix and 1 uL primer to each matching well. Fresh tips are used for every template and primer, and the seal and thermocycling program is recorded as a comment, so all items pass.
